questions.question: You need Node 26.x (currently on 22.x). No version manager (nvm/fnm) detected. How should I proceed?

options.label: Install fnm + Node 26
options.description: Install fnm (Fast Node Manager) and use it to install Node 26.x. Non-destructive, keeps your existing Node.

options.label: Install nvm + Node 26
options.description: Install nvm and use it to install Node 26.x.

options.label: I'll handle Node myself
options.description: Skip Node upgrade — I'll install Node 26.x on my own and re-run setup.
